references.text: The law of selling a thief who cannot repay what he stole can be seen as a parallel to selling someone to pay off debt.
A psalm that speaks about how no one can redeem another with their wealth or give God a ransom for themselves. This points to the limitation of material values in covering human obligations or debts.
The law regarding Hebrew slaves who could be sold to pay debts, but with certain rights and limitations.
Isaiah speaks of those who sell themselves because of their own sin, which can be seen as a spiritual parallel to the physical debt and consequences mentioned in Matthew.
